survivors.why: assertion too broad: /New game/ matches anywhere in the served text, including the script's status strings ("Choose New game to play again"); browser cases click #new-game by id and never read its text
survivors.owning_step: W2/S1 (New game button in the markup)

survivors.quote: shows how many ships remain
survivors.claimed_by: TC_BROWSER_FIRE (the shown count equals the answer's shipsRemaining)
survivors.why: visibility unchecked: the case reads #remaining's textContent, which exists and is correct whether or not the element is visible
survivors.owning_step: W3/S2 C5 (prints shipsRemaining)

survivors.quote: announces each outcome in a
survivors.claimed_by: TC_BROWSER_FIRE ("the status region says nothing about the shot")
survivors.why: assertion too weak: only status !== '' is asserted; the outcome word and ships remaining in the status text are never read
survivors.owning_step: W3/S2 C5 names the mark and the count; no criterion names the status announcement of the outcome

survivors.quote: the grid does not accept input while a shot is in flight
survivors.claimed_by: TC_BROWSER_LOCK (title: "a shot in flight holds the board")
survivors.why: case does not exercise the behaviour: the committed case slows the shot and then clicks New game, never a second cell; the C6 proof's two-cells-in-flight check did not become a committed test case
survivors.owning_step: W3/S2 C6 (clicks while a shot is in flight send nothing; the proof pressed two cells under 600 ms latency)

survivors.quote: Ships may touch.
survivors.claimed_by: none
survivors.why: absent: no case or criterion asserts that touching is permitted; only the no-overlap rule is tested, so a placement rule that forbids adjacency passes
survivors.owning_step: W1/S1 (criteria name no shared cell; none says ships may touch)

survivors.quote: Each ship is attempted at most 200 times
survivors.claimed_by: TC_PLACEMENT_BUDGET
survivors.why: assertion too weak: asserts only that a never-fits source throws an Error naming placement within 5 s; the attempt count is not observed, so 5,000 attempts still pass
survivors.owning_step: W1/S1 (at most 200 attempts per ship)

survivors.quote: at random
survivors.claimed_by: none (TC_FLEET (b) checks that the default source deals a complete fleet; TC_DETERMINISM covers injected seeds)
survivors.why: absent: HTTP and browser cases inject a seeded source, and the system cases assert only invariant totals, so a server whose default source deals one fixed fleet passes
survivors.owning_step: W1/S1 (createGame default random = Math.random)

survivors.quote: (row 0 is the top row)
survivors.claimed_by: TC_WALK and TC_COORDINATES (R-5)
survivors.why: orientation-blind assertions: the HTTP walk counts results over all 100 cells and the corner shots check only status codes; neither compares a shot with a known fleet cell, so swapping row and col passes (rules cases call fire(game,row,col) directly and never see the server's mapping)
survivors.owning_step: W2/S2 (server passes row and col to battleship.fire)

survivors.quote: a non-integer `row`/`col`
survivors.claimed_by: TC_ERROR_TABLE (rows for a fractional row and a quoted row)
survivors.why: absent for col: the table pairs row 1.5 and row "1" with col 0 but has no fractional col; TC_COORDINATES covers col only as -1 and 10
survivors.owning_step: W2/S3 (400 for a row or col that is not an integer in 0..9)

survivors.quote: a non-integer `row`/`col`
survivors.claimed_by: TC_ERROR_TABLE (rows for a fractional row and a quoted row)
survivors.why: absent for col: no quoted col row in the table; the row-side wrong-type row is tested and its col mirror is not
survivors.owning_step: W2/S3 (400 for a row or col that is not an integer in 0..9)

survivors.quote: over 1 MB
survivors.claimed_by: none
survivors.why: boundary absent: only the over-limit body (1 MB + 1) is sent; no case sends a large body that must still be accepted, so a 64 KB limit passes
survivors.owning_step: W2/S3 (413 over 1 MB)

survivors.quote: can be required and exercised in a plain Node process with no server running
survivors.claimed_by: test/battleship.test.js (A-R8.1: "the unit tests, which import only the module")
survivors.why: assertion too weak: importing the module passes while it opens an unref'd listener; nothing asserts that requiring it opens no socket (TC_START (b) checks only server.js's createServer)
survivors.owning_step: W1/S1 (battleship.js with no require, no I/O)
